# Security policy

## Supported versions

DOPPLERGEIST is experimental software. Security fixes are considered for the
current default branch; older revisions and releases may not receive fixes.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report suspected vulnerabilities privately using GitHub's
[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/1337isnot1337/DOPPLERGEIST/security/advisories/new)
form. Do not open a public issue or discussion with vulnerability details.
Include the affected revision or version, impact, a minimal reproduction, and
any relevant environment details. Do not include secrets or private recordings;
describe sensitive evidence and coordinate safe sharing with the maintainer.

Maintainers will review reports and coordinate investigation, fixes, and
appropriate disclosure through the private advisory. Response and fix times
are not guaranteed. For ordinary bugs, use the public issue tracker.
